svg.desc: The 100 nearest stellar systems to Sol from Reyle et al. 2021, A&A 650 A201, VizieR J/A+A/650/A201 tablea1 update 25-Aug-2023. One representative (the brightest catalogued member) is retained per system. Astrometry is propagated to 2026-08-14 00:00:00Z with ERFA eraPmsafe and eraStarpv through ex_astro, rotated from ICRS to the J2000 ecliptic, and orthographically projected with a 66 degree camera tilt. The scene revolves about the ecliptic pole once every 90 seconds. Sol is centered; the outermost system is 20.39 light-years away. Generated by examples/stars.livemd; do not edit by hand.
